prompt: The travel office does not accept a single combined figure. Please _____ the rail fares, hotel charges, and taxi fares so that each amount appears on its own line.
promptZh: 差旅辦公室不接受一筆合計數字。請 _____ 火車票價、旅館費與計程車費，每筆金額各占一行。

options.whyZh: 免除會取消收費義務，但題目沒有要免付任何一筆費用。
估算是推算未知數字，沒有確保各種費用分開列出。
each amount appears on its own line 說明每筆獨立列示，符合 itemize。
round 調整數字的精確度，不會解決費用混成一筆的問題。

explanationZh: each amount appears on its own line 說明每筆獨立列示，符合 itemize。
evidence: The travel office does not accept a single combined figure. Please itemize the rail fares, hotel charges, and taxi fares so that each amount appears on its own line.

vocabulary.note: figure 在本句指一個數目，而非圖形。
